newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 26.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Bedie returns to Abidjan after a month-long trip to China, Singapore and France.
- Teachers in private schools say they do not want the academic year to be declared void after prolonged campus crisis that has shut government-owned universities and colleges.
- Chief opposition leaders Laurent Gbagbo writes open letter to President Bedie on a wide range of national issues, including constitutional reform and freedom of the press.
